title: Mark a fixed phase before the relay handler's final local-host authority read
outcome: The final lease.with_current in serve_mailbox_relay (src/mailbox_relay_rpc.rs, around :130) enters its own fixed phase first. A deadline during that link or StateInner wait is then attributed to that phase, not to the last one the operation entered ("authority" for Describe, "operation" for Read).
acceptance: Mark a fixed phase before the relay handler's final local-host authority read is done
